title: malus × zumi
intro: Malus × zumi, commonly known as Zumi or Korean Crabapple, is a hybrid plant species that combines the genetic traits of Malus baccata and Malus prunifolia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Malus × zumi include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Malus × zumi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
